story.fullStory:
Lady Gaga's "Bloody Mary" reached #41 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Bloody Mary" is a song by American singer Lady Gaga recorded for her second studio album Born This Way (2011).

The song peaked at #41 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 18 weeks on the chart.

Bloody Mary was released in 2011.

Artist: Lady Gaga · Title: Bloody Mary · Album: Born This Way · Year: 2011 · Genre: Synth-pop · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/2010's/Lady Gaga - Bloody Mary.mp4
"Bloody Mary" is a song by American singer Lady Gaga recorded for her second studio album Born This Way (2011).
Gaga wrote the song with Fernando Garibay and Paul "DJ White Shadow" Blair; it was produced by Gaga and DJ White Shadow, with co-production by Garibay and Clinton Sparks.
"Bloody Mary" is an electropop song with elements of synth-pop and trance, and features Gregorian chants.
Born This Way is the second studio album by American singer Lady Gaga.
It was released by Interscope Records on May 23, 2011.
Gaga co-wrote and co-produced it with other producers, including Fernando Garibay and RedOne, who had previously worked with her.
